scope: Phase 6 identity and access on cursor/phase-06-identity-access. The independent review examined commit 78ae1ba8118bfb0279ab4c9094ca2864d1920962, covering the GoTrue boundary, server-custodied sessions, CSRF and origin checks, authorization, forced RLS, delegation and purchasing bounds, workers and service principals, and hosted fail-closed startup. Commit 0dd411c33cb27ae6adef046ccfde9fb12fc21662 requires a service principal on worker routes. Later commits e4491b4396e323d3e5fd79c112a603f37fc32782 and 64f45ac5e41c62e34b8440beeec086fe09f03771 change keyboard focus styling and upgrade libpcre2 in the application images. They do not reopen the worker-route finding.
command: independent security review of cursor/phase-06-identity-access at 78ae1ba8118bfb0279ab4c9094ca2864d1920962

findings.summary: At 78ae1ba, worker routes blocked interactive cookie sessions but still accepted a legacy development JWT when PHASE6_ALLOW_DEV_JWT=1, then executed with the server worker credential. Hosted startup already refused that configuration.

dispositions.resolution: 0dd411c33cb27ae6adef046ccfde9fb12fc21662 rejects worker_once and post_jobs unless principal_type is service.
